m51_bitpack_and_temporal_axis.bit_order_attack_result: LITTLE_WITHIN_BYTE is not observable from popcount alone, but every selected C extent is divisible by eight. Intra-byte bit order therefore cannot move an event across a token boundary or change either N-grid.

atlif_semantics.checkpoint_method: stdlib pickle persistent-storage decode without torch/model import

operator_proxy_attack.assessment: The proxy CSV supplies no ports, lane mapping, recurrence, overlap, memory stalls, or calibrated cycle adapter. Its shares cannot be assigned to the 620868243-cycle envelope; M286 correctly refuses that promotion.

m160.corrected_interpretation: The branch still cannot be dropped blindly because the production dynamic BN2/full branch is nonzero. The frozen-policy reason is not the stale 927 running-stat trigger count.

findings.title: M286 copies M160's rejected running-stat 927 into a frozen no_running audit
findings.evidence: The profile binds bn_policy=no_running. M160's independent hammer marks the static running-stat path P0 and independently obtains zero_fc1_sn2_active=0 and full_zero_sn2_active=0, whereas M286 publishes m160_zero_input_sn2_active_values=927.
findings.impact: The overall G8 no-go is conservative and remains correct, but one of its central zero-input boundary facts is not valid for the frozen execution policy.
findings.required_fix: Replace 927 with the corrected no_running semantics: sn2 remains inactive for zero FC1, while dynamic BN2/full-branch behavior is nonzero and requires explicit modeling or a validated policy change.

findings.title: The author contract binds raw M156/M160 artifacts but omits their independent corrections
findings.evidence: The M286 contract hashes the raw M156 and M160 results, not the independent review artifacts. This allowed the known-rejected M160 value to remain identity-valid.
findings.impact: A byte-stable replay can still reproduce semantically superseded evidence.
findings.required_fix: Bind independent review SHAs or corrected successor artifacts whenever a downstream eligibility decision imports a reviewed boundary.

findings.title: 105-module ATLIF census has only 93 runtime rows
findings.evidence: Independent checkpoint recovery finds 105 binary official_atlif modules and reproduces all threshold statistics, but profile summary.atlif_rows contains 93 unique runtime rows.
findings.impact: The G7 amplitude no-go is unaffected because checkpoint modes and thresholds close the proof, but binary_activity_mean and runtime-coverage wording should not imply 105 observed rows.
findings.required_fix: Report checkpoint census 105/105 separately from runtime-row coverage 93/105 and explain the 12 unobserved modules.

findings.title: G8 is a 10-of-12 binary-FC1-input subset, not an all-FFN result
findings.evidence: Exactly 100 payloads cover ten binary FC1 modules; both stage-3 FFNs and every FC2 input payload are absent by contract.
findings.impact: The selected-axis no-go is useful, but an unqualified 'whole temporal FFN' label can be read as full-network coverage.
findings.required_fix: Carry '10 binary FC1 modules / 100 local payloads; stage3 and FC2 excluded' into every table, pivot decision, and later paper-facing statement.

next_action: Accept the G7/G8 negative pivot, repair the M160 annotation and review bindings, and spend hardware effort on a cycle-adapted destination-block or remaining-budget mechanism rather than on these two rejected main axes.
